evals.prompt: Convert docs/MIPs/MIP-0091-marola-forecaster-architecture.md to ASD-STE100. The owner asked for it.
evals.expected_output: The MIP's prose rewritten to STE100 with references/ste100.md, the metadata and Readiness tables, headings, code spans, numbers, R-identifiers and links unchanged, a style marker mip+ste100 added, ste_check.py run, and a report that lists sentences kept outside the rules and requirements whose force may have changed. No humanizer pass.
assertions: Resolves the style as mip, converted to STE100 on the owner's instruction, and says so
Reads references/ste100.md before the rewrite
Leaves the Status and Blocked by values, every heading, code span, number and link unchanged
Runs scripts/ste_check.py on the file and reports its totals
Lists each sentence kept outside the rules with a reason
Lists each requirement whose meaning or normative force possibly changed, for the owner to confirm
Does not run humanizer or marola-humanizar on the result
Does not claim that an automated STE100 or Vale check passed

evals.prompt: I added a paragraph to docs/3-Ways-of-working/DEV-FLOW.md about restacking. Polish the wording before I push.
evals.expected_output: Style resolved as guide from the path default; the paragraph tightened under the AGENTS.md prose rule; the devkit humanizer run last; no STE100 conversion of the page; just quality named as the gate.
assertions: States the style guide and that the path default gave it
Does not convert the page, or the paragraph, to STE100
Runs the English humanizer skill last, or names it as not loaded
Changes only the paragraph the user named
Keeps links relative inside the repo, per .claude/rules/docs.md

evals.prompt: Run the humanizer over AGENTS.md and the eli5 skill so they sound less robotic.
evals.expected_output: A refusal of the humanizer pass with the reason: both files are agent-facing, where a humanizer pass is never permitted. An offer to tighten them under the agent-facing rules instead.
assertions: Resolves both files as agent-facing
Does not run humanizer on either file
Gives the reason: the pass replaces exact words with natural ones in text a model follows
Offers the agent-facing rules (imperative, one instruction per sentence, pointers not copies) as the alternative

evals.prompt: Escreve uma versão em linguagem simples, em português, do MIP-0091, como MIP-0091.easy.pt-BR.md.
evals.expected_output: A plain-style Portuguese version that gives the answer first, keeps every fact and number of the MIP, adds none, links to the MIP, says that an Accepted MIP is not built yet, and ends with a marola-humanizar pass. No STE100.
assertions: Resolves the style as plain from the *.easy.pt-BR.md path
Writes Portuguese from the meaning, not a word-by-word translation
Keeps the MIP's numbers and limits and adds no fact that the MIP lacks
Does not describe the Accepted MIP's design as already built
Routes the final pass to marola-humanizar, or names it as not loaded
Does not apply STE100 to the Portuguese text

evals.prompt: Rewrite the commit message and PR description for this branch so they read well.
evals.expected_output: Style change-record: a commit body with the Tested: and Co-Authored-By trailers and nothing else, the PR body left to just pr and the template rather than written by hand.
assertions: Resolves the style as change-record
Keeps exactly the two trailers AGENTS.md names and adds no attribution banner
Uses just pr for the PR body instead of writing it by hand
Does not apply STE100
